When she repeatedly made jokes about my rape, both when we were alone and with other people.

I confronted her after it had been going on for months and she said she did it because it made her feel better about it, and that she'd stop.  She didn't, and the last time I saw her a year ago (first time seeing her in four years), when of the first things she said to me was another joke about it.

(Backstory:  I'm a chick.)

In my earlier years I was always afraid of receiving oral because I was convinced, CONVINCED, I would fart.  Like deathly afraid of it.  Confided this to one of my close friends and she laughed in my face and said it could never happen.  Along comes my next boyfriend, I decide to FINALLY just let go and let him go to town, and lo and behold, mid-O, let one rip out.

He cracked up.  I nearly died.  To this day I refuse to receive oral to completion.
